project_info.color_palette: White, Navy Blue, Red, Gold, Wood Brown

main_subject.detail: A financial explainer poster featuring the headline 'LE SMIC PASSE À 12,31 € EN FRANCE', a chalkboard labeled 'SMIC 2026', stacked euro coins, a pink piggy bank, and a white stat card listing gross and estimated net values.
main_subject.style: Editorial finance infographic with realistic tabletop props, bold price typography, and clean bilingual policy-brief layout.

composition_elements.text:

12,31 €

SMIC 2026

items: Top Left: Large navy and red wage headline block.
Top Right: Blurred French flag backdrop behind chalkboard, piggy bank, and calculator.
Bottom Left: White rounded stat panel with three icon rows for hourly, gross monthly, and estimated net monthly SMIC values.
Bottom Right: Calculator keyboard corner, stacked euro coins, and pink piggy bank beside the chalkboard.
Center/Background: Wooden tabletop scene with a small blackboard reading 'SMIC 2026'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm natural shadows on desk objects, gentle flag blur in background, sharp numeric readability, and informative editorial tone.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality financial explainer poster for France's 2026 minimum wage. Centerpiece is a tabletop scene with a small chalkboard reading 'SMIC 2026', euro coins, piggy bank, and calculator, while the left side features the bold headline 'LE SMIC PASSE À 12,31 € EN FRANCE'. Background is a softly blurred French flag. Surrounding elements: white stat card with gross and net values, line 'Depuis le 1er juin 2026', and a footer note about supporting purchasing power. Technical style: photoreal financial explainer poster, soft tabletop studio lighting, sharp numeric readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
